messages:
alice: :rotating_light: incidentbot didn't create PD incident for PROD payment errors at 03:12 UTC — webhook returns 403. Noticed customer errors spike.
ben: seeing same in logs, grabbing headers now.
sre-bot: delivery_error: POST https://hooks.redwood.internal/incidentbot 403 Unauthorized - token validation failed (x-request-id=abc123)
alice: I manually paged @sam-oncall at 03:18, fyi. CS says ~2% checkout failures between 03:05-03:25.
sam-oncall: oncall here, ack. joining.
devops-lead: quick repro from my laptop:
```
curl -v -X POST https://hooks.redwood.internal/incidentbot \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer s.eyJ.invalid" \
  -d '{"alert":"payment-timeout"}'
* HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< Content-Type: application/json
< {
<   "error":"unauthorized",
<   "detail":"token rotated"
< }
```
ben: that's the rotated token. KSM rotation ran at 02:58 but the incidentbot integration wasn't updated by the deploy helper due to a race with the secret-sync job.
carla: customer impact: two merchants reported degraded checkout, one opened a support ticket at 03:22. Finance flagged possible revenue impact.
alice: good catch. who manually paged? I did. thanks @sam-oncall for jumping in.
sam-oncall: landed a temporary manual page and started mitigation with payments team.
ben: rolling back token rotation on the incidentbot secret now (reapplying previous secret to ksm). patch posted to infra-repo.
ben: rollback applied at 03:31 — monitoring delivery now.
sre-bot: webhook_delivery_resume: success - queue_processed=8 delayed_alerts=8
pagerduty-bot: created incident PD-8273 for missed paging window (created 03:33 UTC)
devops-lead: immediate mitigations: 1) rollback to previous token (done), 2) manual page done, 3) CS notified. Next steps: add post-rotation smoke test and a 403-rate alert.
alice: please add runbook item: after any secret rotation, run a quick webhook smokecheck that posts a test alert and verifies 200/201 from incidentbot. If 403, trigger auto-rollback and notify #eng-oncall.
carla: I'll coordinate customer comms. drafting a short note for affected merchants.
ben: follow-up tasks I'm owning:
- add validation to secret-rotation job to wait for secret-sync to confirm update (PR incoming)
- add 403/401 rate alert to Pager (threshold >5/min)
- reconcile which alerts were dropped and create follow-up PD ticket for cleanup
ETA for PR: EOD today.
devops-lead: action items (blameless):
1) add webhook 403 monitor + dashboard
2) add rotation smokecheck (post-rotation test)
3) make secret-sync idempotent and add retries
4) update incidentbot runbook with manual fallback steps
owner: devops-lead, ETA: EOD tomorrow
sam-oncall: will write the short postmortem (blameless) and link missed-alerts list. I'll include customer impact summary.
alice: thanks all. once postmortem posted, schedule a short retro with infra and oncall to cover process gaps. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: automated note: incidentbot webhook queue drained at 03:33 UTC, delayed_pager_count=8, resumed=true
carla: CS comms sent to affected merchants at 04:02 UTC. keeping them updated.
sam-oncall: closing the live incident here — we'll track the action items in the postmortem. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
summary: incidentbot webhook token rotation caused 403s and missed pages; manual escalation performed; rollback and fixes planned
